	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_north_talks_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_accepted
				COLDWAR_IRQ_northern_settlement_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_autonomy_guarantees_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_autonomy_guarantees_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						166 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_autonomy_guarantees_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_autonomy_guarantees_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_autonomy_guarantees_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_autonomy_guarantees_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					166 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_autonomy_guarantees_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_guarantees_pending

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_popular_organizations = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_invoice = 0.015 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_mass_party_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_popular_organizations_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_party_schools = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_cadre_party_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_party_schools_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_party_schools_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_party_schools_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_party_schools_0_instruction bonus = 0.2 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_party_schools_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_schools_pending }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_enterprise_accounts_implemented }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_citizenship_implemented }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_social_bargain_implemented }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_instruction bonus = 0.3 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_baath_continuity_cabinet_unlocked
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_bakr_continuity = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_invoice = 0.005 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_bakr_in_office = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_council_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_loyal_officers_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_continuity_pending }
	}
}

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_deputy_budget_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_deputy_budget_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_deputy_budget_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_deputy_budget_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_bakr_development = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_bakr_in_office = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_guarantees_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_deputy_budget_implemented
				}
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						557 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					557 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_pending }
	}
}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_bakr_in_office = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_treaty_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_treaty_0_credit value = 15.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_treaty_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					army_experience = 15
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_treaty_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_bakr_soviet_offer_unlocked
			COLDWAR_IRQ_focus_owned_bakr_treaty = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_pending }
	}
}

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_bakr_in_office = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_unity_pending

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_bakr_technical_mission = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_bakr_in_office = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_instruction bonus = 0.3 uses = 1 category = CAT_construction }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_instruction bonus = 0.25 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_pending }
	}
}

			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_saddam_in_office = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_security_bureau_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_technocrats_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_social_contract_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_saddam_industry = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_invoice = 0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_saddam_in_office = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_regional_role_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						557 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					557 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_officer_staff = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_merit_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0_instruction cost_reduction = 0.25 uses = 1 category = land_doctrine }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1_credit value = 25.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					army_experience = 25
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_pending }
	}
}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_state_budget_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_officer_amnesty_offer_unlocked
			COLDWAR_IRQ_focus_owned_officer_amnesty = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_amnesty_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_arab_state_contracts = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_invoice = 0.05 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_sector_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						557 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					557 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_pending }
	}
}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_civil_diplomacy_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_civil_diplomacy_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_civil_diplomacy_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_arab_training_network = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_invoice = 0.015 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_technical_exchange_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_training_network_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_training_network_0_credit value = 15.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_training_network_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					army_experience = 15
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_training_network_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_training_network_pending }
	}
}

				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes

				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_union_convention_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_compact_accepted
				OR = {
					AND = {
						country_exists = EGY
						NOT = { has_war_with = EGY }
						OR = {
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_accepted_arab_development_offer_EGY
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_accepted_arab_union_offer_EGY
						}
					}
					AND = {
						country_exists = SYR
						NOT = { has_war_with = SYR }
						OR = {
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_accepted_arab_development_offer_SYR
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_accepted_arab_union_offer_SYR
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_union_accounts_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_union_accounts_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_union_accounts_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_union_accounts_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_union_accounts_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_underground_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_membership_pending

			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_state_unions_invoice = 0.01 }

		if = {

				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_vanguard_implemented }

				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_state_unions_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_state_unions_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_icp_industrial_workers = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_invoice = 0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_national_question_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						557 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					557 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_pending }
	}
}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_aziz_muhammad_in_office = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_opposition_road_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_resilient_networks_pending }

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_implemented }
		}

			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_invoice = 0.015 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_aziz_muhammad_in_office = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_unitary_left_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_language_rights_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_language_rights_0_credit value = 0.015 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_language_rights_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0.015 }
					update_literacy_rate = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_language_rights_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_language_rights_pending }
	}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_aziz_safe_return = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_invoice = 0.015 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_aziz_muhammad_in_office = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_united_opposition_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_safe_return_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_safe_return_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_safe_return_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_safe_return_0_instruction bonus = 0.3 uses = 1 category = CAT_construction }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_aziz_safe_return_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_aziz_safe_return_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_civic_local_accounts = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_unitary_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_local_accounts_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_civic_education = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_security_oversight_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_education_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_education_0_credit value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_education_0_credit value = 0.02 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0.005 }
					update_literacy_rate = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_education_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0.025 }
					update_literacy_rate = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_education_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_pending }
	}
}

					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_universities_0_credit value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_universities_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = {
						name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_universities_0_instruction
						bonus = 0.3
						uses = 2
						category = CAT_information_technology
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_universities_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_universities_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_universities_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_universities_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_universities_implemented

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_royal_parliament = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_ceremonial_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_parliament_pending }
	}
}

					}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_invoice = 0.03 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_service_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_royal_public_works_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_royal_public_works_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						171 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_royal_public_works_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_royal_public_works_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_royal_public_works_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_royal_public_works_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					171 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_royal_public_works_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_royal_public_works_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_foreign_border_delivery = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_settlement_implemented }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_border_settlement_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_border_delivery_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_border_delivery_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						1124 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_border_delivery_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_border_delivery_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_border_delivery_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_border_delivery_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					1124 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_border_delivery_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_situation_delivered
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_border_delivery_pending }
	}
}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }

						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_syria_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}

				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_foreign_syria_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_syria_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_syria_reward_v3_pending

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_syria_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_foreign_syria_pending

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_kdp_autonomy_budget = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 6 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_accepted
				COLDWAR_IRQ_northern_settlement_active = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_autonomy_budget_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_kdp_language = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 6 }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_succession_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_civic_councils_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_language_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_language_0_credit value = 0.02 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_language_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0.02 }
					update_literacy_rate = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_language_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_kdp_mountain_routes = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_invoice = 0.03 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 6 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_language_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_mountain_routes_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_mountain_routes_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						164 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_mountain_routes_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_mountain_routes_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_mountain_routes_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_mountain_routes_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					164 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_kdp_mountain_routes_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_mountain_routes_pending }
	}
}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_formed
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_regional_cooperation_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_joint_services_pending

			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_invoice = 0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_formed
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_constitution_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						630 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }

			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					630 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_pending

					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_trade_routes_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						630 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_trade_routes_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_trade_routes_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_trade_routes_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_trade_routes_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					630 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_trade_routes_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_trade_routes_pending }
	}
}

					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_student_exchange_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }

					}

				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_student_exchange_0
			}

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 9 }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_formed
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_returnees_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes

					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_sciri_patron_compact_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_sciri_patron_compact_0_credit value = 15.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_sciri_patron_compact_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					army_experience = 15
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_sciri_patron_compact_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_patron_compact_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_sciri_sciri_independent_relations
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_sciri_sciri_patron_compact

			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}

			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes

		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_invoice = 0.015 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 12 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_directorial_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_associations_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes

		}
