			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 12 }
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_national_compact_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0_credit value = 0.015 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0.015 }
					update_literacy_rate = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_pending }
	}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_oil_nationalize = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_invoice = 0.025 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_accounts_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_nationalize_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_nationalize_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_nationalize_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_IRQ_ipc_marketing_transition days = 90 }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_nationalize_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_oil_oil_renegotiate
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_oil_oil_nationalize
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_nationalize_pending }
	}
}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_oil_concession_offer_unlocked
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_oil_oil_nationalize

						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_concession_delivery_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }

					}
					171 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_concession_delivery_0
			}

				if = {
					limit = {

					}

					}

				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_concession_delivery_1
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_reward_v3_pending

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_invoice = 0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_technical_training_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_diversification_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_diversification_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						557 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_diversification_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_diversification_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_diversification_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_diversification_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					557 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_oil_diversification_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_industrial_fund_implemented
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_diversification_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_oil_oil_revenue_state

		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_survey_pending
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_industry_heavy = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_invoice = 0.05 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						557 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					557 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_0
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_1_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_1_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_1_instruction bonus = 0.35 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_heavy_1
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_steel_implemented
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_industry_pipeline_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_industry_reallocate_unlocked
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_industry_industry_light
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_industry_industry_heavy
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_industry_light = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_invoice = 0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_light_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_light_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						166 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_light_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_light_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_light_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_light_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					166 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_light_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_consumers_implemented
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_industry_pipeline_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_industry_reallocate_unlocked
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_industry_industry_heavy
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_industry_industry_light
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_pending }
	}
}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_invoice = 0.03 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_light_implemented
				}
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_grid_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_grid_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						557 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_grid_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_grid_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_grid_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_grid_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					557 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_grid_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_grid_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_industry_maintenance = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_public_accounts_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_debt_accounts_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_invoice = 0.05 }

			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_maintenance_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						171 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = fossil_powerplant size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }

					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					171 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = fossil_powerplant level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_industry_power_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_power_package_earned

			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_invoice = 0.04 }

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_water_accounts_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_large_irrigation_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_large_irrigation_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						1141 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_large_irrigation_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_large_irrigation_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_large_irrigation_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_large_irrigation_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					1141 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_large_irrigation_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_large_irrigation_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_agriculture_agri_local_irrigation

			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes

					update_literacy_rate = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_society_baseline_0
			}

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_invoice = 0.01 }

		}

				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_reserve_training_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes

					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_procurement_board_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_procurement_board_0_credit value = 20.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {

					}
					army_experience = 20
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_procurement_board_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_reward_v3_pending

						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_air_maintenance_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_air_maintenance_0_instruction bonus = 0.35 uses = 1 category = CAT_aircraft }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_air_maintenance_0
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_air_maintenance_1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_air_maintenance_1_credit value = 15.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_air_maintenance_1_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					air_experience = 15
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_air_maintenance_1
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_air_maintenance_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_air_maintenance_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_air_maintenance_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_air_maintenance_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_air_maintenance_pending

						}
					}
					AND = {

					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_coastal_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_coastal_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_coastal_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}

					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_coastal_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_coastal_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {

						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_coastal_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					171 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_defence_coastal_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_coastal_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_coastal_reward_v3_pending

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_crisis_channel_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_crisis_channel_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_crisis_channel_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_crisis_channel_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_war_mediation_unlocked
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_crisis_channel_pending }

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_war_deliberate_authority = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_offensive_option_implemented }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_deliberate_authority_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_deliberate_authority_0_credit value = 25.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_deliberate_authority_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					army_experience = 25
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_deliberate_authority_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_war_authorization_unlocked
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_pending }
	}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_war_civil_continuity = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_crisis_channel_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_deliberate_authority_implemented
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_civil_continuity_pending }
	}
}

		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_economy_implemented }
				has_war = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_procurement_cycle_package_earned

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_war_reconstruction = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_invoice = 0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_accounts_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reconstruction_need
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						171 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					171 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_pending }
	}
}

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reintegration_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unlock_kuwait_integration = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_war_sanctions_response = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_credit_burden_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0_credit value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0_instruction bonus = 0.35 uses = 2 category = CAT_industry }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_war_sanctions_diplomacy_unlocked
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_pending }
	}
}

					}
					add_state_claim = 399
					add_war_support = 0.05
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_arabistan_claim_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_arabistan_claim_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_arabistan_claim_reward_v3_pending

						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_short_war_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {

					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_plan
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_short_war_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_war_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_war_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_war_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_war_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_war_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_iran_war_iran_sustained_war
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_policy_iran_war_iran_short_war
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_iran_fuel_spares = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_invoice = 0.03 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_war_implemented }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_fuel_spares_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_fuel_spares_0_credit value = 20.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_fuel_spares_0_credit value = 10.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					army_experience = 10
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_fuel_spares_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					army_experience = 20
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_fuel_spares_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_fuel_spares_pending }
	}
}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_invoice = 0.05 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_sustained_war_implemented }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_mobilisation_base_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_mobilisation_base_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						167 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = no }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_mobilisation_base_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_mobilisation_base_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_mobilisation_base_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_mobilisation_base_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					167 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_mobilisation_base_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_mobilisation_base_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_forward_depots_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_war_contracts_implemented
				}
				country_exists = PER
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { has_war_with = PER }
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = PER }
				399 = { is_owned_by = PER }
				399 = { is_claimed_by = IRQ }
				NOT = { COLDWAR_IRQ_border_settlement_active = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_final_ultimatum_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_final_ultimatum_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_final_ultimatum_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { wargoal_on = PER }
					set_temp_variable = { wargoal_type = 2 }
					add_threat_from_wargoal_effect = yes
					create_wargoal = {
						type = take_state_focus
						target = PER
						generator = { 399 }
						expire = 180
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_final_ultimatum_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_final_ultimatum_reward_v3_current

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_final_ultimatum_package_earned

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_final_ultimatum_pending

			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}

			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_invoice = 0.015 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_quoted
		}
		if = {

				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes

				controls_state = 399
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_secure_khuzestan_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_secure_khuzestan_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {

					}
					399 = { add_compliance = 3 }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_secure_khuzestan_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_reward_v3_pending

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_iran_oil_rehabilitation = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_invoice = 0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_secure_khuzestan_implemented }
				399 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_oil_rehabilitation_0
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_oil_rehabilitation_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						399 = {
							is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
							free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_oil_rehabilitation_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_oil_rehabilitation_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_oil_rehabilitation_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_oil_rehabilitation_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					399 = {
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_oil_rehabilitation_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_oil_rehabilitation_pending

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_no_easy_exit_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_no_easy_exit_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_iran_war_aims_unlocked
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_no_easy_exit_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_iran_provincial_settlement = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_regional_power_implemented }
				399 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ }
				NOT = { has_war_with = PER }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_provincial_settlement_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_provincial_settlement_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_provincial_settlement_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					399 = { add_compliance = 5 }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_provincial_settlement_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_provincial_settlement_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_apply_iran_core_khuzestan = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_focus_owned_reforms = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
	COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_implemented }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_invoice = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_invoice = 0.06 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_quoted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_equal_citizenship_implemented
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_central_administration_implemented
				}
				399 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
					NOT = { is_core_of = IRQ }
					infrastructure > 2
					NOT = { compliance < 60 }
					resistance < 15
				}
				NOT = { has_war_with = PER }
				has_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_khuzestan_hold_since days > 729 }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_quoted
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_core_khuzestan_0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_core_khuzestan_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_core_khuzestan_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					399 = { add_core_of = IRQ }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iran_core_khuzestan_0
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_reward_v3_pending
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_package_earned
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_implemented
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_pending
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_core_khuzestan_pending }
	}
}
